oaks_own.title: I urge you to keep the commandments and be true to the covenants so many of you have made to guide you along the covenant path.
oaks_own.label: Keep the commandments and your covenants
items: I urge you to keep the commandments and be true to the covenants so many of you have made to guide you along the covenant path.

oaks_own.title: These promises from the Book of Mormon are true. Millions believe them and have had experiences to affirm their truth. I invite all to believe them.
oaks_own.label: Believe the Book of Mormon's promises
items: These promises from the Book of Mormon are true. Millions believe them and have had experiences to affirm their truth. I invite all to believe them.

oaks_own.title: I call upon all to act on these truths and to share them with others that we may all draw closer to Jesus Christ, our Savior.
oaks_own.label: Act on these truths and share them
items: I call upon all to act on these truths and to share them with others that we may all draw closer to Jesus Christ, our Savior.
I invite you to do something that is as simple as gospel fruit is delicious: love, share, and invite.

oaks_own.title: As the talks of this conference are published, we invite all to study and ponder them prayerfully and to act in faith on the principles they explain.
oaks_own.label: Study the conference talks and act on them
items: As the talks of this conference are published, we invite all to study and ponder them prayerfully and to act in faith on the principles they explain.
let us not be guilty of holding “the oracles of God … as a light thing”

oaks_repeated.title: let us follow Him by forgoing contention and by using the language and methods of peacemakers. In our families and other personal relationships, let us avoid what is harsh and hateful.
oaks_repeated.label: Forgo contention; speak as a peacemaker
items: let us follow Him by forgoing contention and by using the language and methods of peacemakers. In our families and other personal relationships, let us avoid what is harsh and hateful.
Let us avoid what is harsh and hateful. Let us seek to be holy, like our Savior.
let us use words that encourage understanding and peace
let us fill our hearts with the true doctrine of Christ
Let us repent for the harsh language and expressions that have offended our friends, leaders, family members, or colleagues.
Let us pray for peaceful communication among us, regardless of the difference in our opinions.
Let us use the language that uplifts, edifies, comforts, and brings people together.

oaks_repeated.title: number seven is an invitation from our prophet, President Dallin H. Oaks: “Seek friends … who are striving to follow the Lord … with whom you can feel the Spirit and … reinforce your faith.”
oaks_repeated.label: Seek friends who follow the Lord
items: number seven is an invitation from our prophet, President Dallin H. Oaks: “Seek friends … who are striving to follow the Lord … with whom you can feel the Spirit and … reinforce your faith.”

Let us put compassion into action and minister to the person in front of us.
I plead with you as disciples of Jesus Christ to pray to see others as He sees them and to treat them accordingly.
This week, I invite you to: Learn the name of someone who may feel unseen.
Pray to see others as Heavenly Father sees them.

I invite you to look at your life and what you want to achieve with enthusiasm and the certainty that your Father in Heaven will guide you on that journey

counsel: Focus on developing your faith in God and the mission of His Son, Jesus Christ.
Hold on to the first article of faith even if something else is uncertain. And while you wait, wait upon the Lord
Never let your secular learning limit your spiritual horizons.
Protect yourself with the weekly renewing of your covenants by partaking of the sacrament and with consistent efforts to live according to those sacred covenants.
Join us at TempleSquare.org or through the Temple Square app to learn more.
